scope: Round-3 spec re-review of the issue #50 change against the original 41a4fa01 protocol, covering the added local_preflight_directory, the string-id requirement on approved_amendments, the refreshed helper hashes and all earlier changes.

checks.question: 1. Protocol changes confined to the named fields
checks.detail: Parsed-JSON diff of the current protocol against 5c74e4d (41a4fa01...) shows only the 9 paths in changed_protocol_paths. The only path new since round 2 is data_policy.local_preflight_directory. partition, budget, ceilings, questions, case_matrix, code pins, oracle_policy, legacy_inputs, freeze (15 supporting_artifacts), correction_approval, p9, claim_limits and the other recipes fields are unchanged.

checks.question: 2. Bound files byte-identical and listed hashes match
checks.detail: git diff 5c74e4d is empty for MANIFEST.json, inputs/, oracles/, certificates/, independent-review.json, quality-review.json, authoring-validation.json and evaluation/inquiry-p8. review-package.json was skipped as instructed. freeze.manifest_sha256, all 15 supporting_artifacts, the generator, independent audit tool and certificate producer hashes, and all 10 additional_helpers match current bytes.

checks.question: 3. Repeated-requests wording true
checks.detail: MANIFEST.json is byte-identical to round 1. All 96 cases expect 'results'. Across the 16 repeated-requests cases the highest counter-to-limit ratio is 352/1000 pairs (T01-repeated-requests-8), and expected_embedded_event_count is 0 against a limit of 8.

checks.question: 4. repository_cost accurate
checks.detail: Recomputed: unique blob content of the failed capture, replay and preflight directories is 68,187,944 B (about 68 MB), and the text calls it unique content. The other figures were measured in round 2 and the evidence is unchanged: about 62 MB per capture or replay directory, a 42 MB lean.gz and a 6 MB preflight directory. local_preflight_directory now names preflight-<fresh-run-id>, matching the failed attempt's preflight-20261012T225824Z-a904130 layout, so the policy names every directory the cost statement says is committed.

checks.question: 5. Self-consistency and loader enforcement of approval_location
checks.detail: The loader requires approved_amendments to be a list of objects, each with a string id, and the ids to be unique. A deferred amendment needs non-blank string approval_text and interpretation_sha256 equal to the SHA256 of the UTF-8 interpretation. The data policy must be an object with state requires-correction-receipt and data_policy_sha256 equal to digest(json_bytes(policy)). These match both approval_location texts. A valid receipt still passes, and the frozen-copy test loads only with receipt approvals.

checks.question: 6. README accuracy
checks.detail: README names all three directories, gives the json_bytes encoding with the trailing newline, and lists the refusal conditions (omission, repeated id, non-string id, different text), all consistent with the loader.

checks.question: 7. No weakening of the original suite
checks.detail: evaluation/inquiry-p8 is byte-identical to 5c74e4d. The receipt check runs only for recipe versions other than inquiry-p8-recipes@1. load_suite(evaluation/inquiry-p8/MANIFEST.json) succeeds and the original generator --check passes.

checks.question: Commands run
checks.detail: test/inquiry_approval_receipt.py: 3 tests OK, now covering missing and non-string ids. test/inquiry_corrected_candidates.py: 16 tests OK. Corrected generator --check: 96 cases checked. independent_finite_audit.py: AUTHORING-CHECK, 80 exact checks, no findings. Original generator --check OK. No driver or consumer run.

findings.detail: Carried from round 2: the supplemental receipts must be bound in review-package.json in the commit the researcher approves. That is pending by design and not reviewed here. load_suite checks only the commit's 40-hex format.

Carried from round 2: require_receipt_approvals silently ignores receipt entries whose id the protocol does not defer (verified with an extra {'id': 'unrelated'} entry). This cannot let an unapproved item through.
